title: NBA: Doncic's 53 points lift Lakers as Cavs top Sixers in James' return
summary: Luka Doncic poured in 53 points to propel the Los Angeles Lakers to a 124-118 NBA Cup victory over Portland on Friday as LeBron James's latest return to Cleveland ended in defeat.
